name: Intelligence Production & Dissemination
description: Producing finished intelligence products and disseminating them to appropriate audiences. Covers the intelligence cycle (requirements, collection, processing, analysis, dissemination), structured analytical techniques, confidence assessment, writing intelligence reports at tactical, operational, and strategic levels, and tailoring products to stakeholder needs.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to intelligence production or the intelligence cycle

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the intelligence cycle and the types of intelligence products
evidence: Can describe the phases of the intelligence cycle
Understands the difference between tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence
Aware of structured analytical techniques and their purpose

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Contributes to intelligence products under supervision
evidence: Drafts tactical intelligence summaries (e.g., flash alerts, IOC bulletins) under guidance
Applies basic confidence language and source assessment to analytical judgments
Tailors communication to specified audience under mentor guidance
Drafts reviewed and edited by authorized analyst before dissemination

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently produces intelligence products across multiple report types
evidence: Authors tactical and operational intelligence reports across 3+ engagements
Applies structured analytical techniques to reduce bias
Uses proper confidence language (ODNI ICD 203 or equivalent)
Intelligence products pass editorial and analytical review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Produces strategic intelligence; defines requirements; mentors junior analysts
evidence: Authors strategic intelligence assessments for executive audiences
Defines and manages intelligence requirements based on organizational priorities
Applies advanced analytical techniques (ACH, red team analysis, scenario planning)
Reviews and mentors junior analysts on intelligence writing and analytical rigor

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines intelligence production methodology; establishes analytical standards; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's intelligence production methodology and templates
Establishes analytical standards and quality control processes
Publishes intelligence research recognized outside the organization
Trains teams on intelligence analysis, writing, and structured analytical techniques

assessment_methods.description: Review intelligence reports for analytical rigor, proper confidence language, source assessment, and audience appropriateness
Given a collection of raw intelligence data, produce a finished intelligence product with key judgments, confidence levels, and recommendations

mitre_attack.note: Covers production of intelligence across all ATT&CK techniques and tactics
